xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Power of Death: Reduce all melee damage you receive by <Num0>% for the next minute while the staff remains equipped. Stacks with Protect from Melee. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しのちから：１ぶんあいだこのつえをそうびしているあいだ、うけるきんせつダメージを<Num0>%かるいへ。「きんせつのくわえご」とおもいふくか。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Rampage: Drain your Attack, Defence, Ranged & Magic levels by <Num0>%, while increasing your Strength by <Num1> levels, plus <Num2>% of the drained levels. (<Num3>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ランページ：こうげきりょく・しゅびりょく・えんしゃ・まほうレベルを<Num0>%ていした、ていしたりょうの<Num1>%+<Num2>レベルのわんりょくをじょうげる。(<Num3>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Lumber Up: Increase your Woodcutting level by <Num0>. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ランバー・アップ：きこりレベルを<Num0>じょうげる。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Rock Knocker: Increase your Mining level by <Num0>. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ロック・ノッカー：さいくつレベルを<Num0>じょうげる。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Puncture: Deal two quick slashes with <Num0>% increased accuracy and <Num1>% increased damage. (<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: パンクチャ：めいちゅうりつ＋<Num0>%、ダメージ+<Num1>%のすばやいきりさけきで２かいこうげき。(<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Backstab: Deal an attack with greatly increased accuracy on unsuspecting targets and that lowers your target's Defence level by the damage dealt. (<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: バックスタブ：むぼうそなたいしょうにめいちゅうりつをだいはばにじょうげたこうげきをいきい、あたえダメージぶんだけたいしょうのしゅびりょくレベルをていした。(<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Sanctuary: Temporarily increase your Defence level by <Num0>. (<Num1>%)

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Cleave: Deal a powerful attack that inflicts <Num0>% more damage. (<Num1>%)

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Cleave: Deal a powerful attack that inflicts <Num0>% more damage with <Num1>% increased accuracy and increased speed. (<Num2>%)

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

If hit, the opponent will take <Num2>% increased damage for the next <Num3> seconds. This special attack can only be used within the Tombs of Amascut. (<Num4>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: アマスカットのいかり：めいちゅうりつ+<Num0>%、あたえダメージ+<Num1>%、こうげきはやいどはんげんでこうげき。いのちちゅうしたばあい、あいてはそのあと<Num3>びょうあいだ、<Num2>%ふくわえしたダメージをうける。このひっさつわざはアマスカットのはかでのみはつうごきかのう。(<Num4>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Tumeken's Light: Sacrifice <Num0> prayer points to restore your hitpoints to <Num1>% above their maximum, cure all poison, restore all drained stats (except prayer) and fully restore your run energy. This special attack can only be used within the Tombs of Amascut. (<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ツメケンのひかり：いのりりょくポイント<Num0>きえひ、たいりょくをさいだいねの<Num1>%までかいふくし、すべてのどくをなおし、ぜんてのていしたステータス（いのりをのぞきく）とはしりちからをぜんかいふく。このひっさつわざはアマスカットのはかでのみはつうごきかのう。(<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Swarm: Fire <Num0> times in quick succession, dealing reduced damage and inflicting poison. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: だいむれ： ていしたダメージとどくをあたえるこうげきを<Num0>かいはなしつ。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Bear Down: Perform an attack with double accuracy, dealing additional damage over time, draining your target's agility level and preventing them from running. (<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ベアダウン：2ばいのめいちゅうりつでこうげき。ついかでつぎつづきダメージをあたえ、たいしょうのうんどうしんけいレベルをしたげ、はしりれなくする。(<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Condemn: Fire a powerful spell with increased accuracy and damage, lowering your target's magic and defence levels by up to <Num0>%. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: きゅうだん：めいちゅうりつとダメージがふくわえしたきょうりょくなまほうをはなしち、たいしょうのまほうちからとぼうぎょちからをさいだい<Num0>%ていしたさせる。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Disrupt: Summon a powerful bolt of lightning that deals guaranteed magic damage based on your max hit. (<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: こみみだ：きょうりょくないなつまでたしかみにさいだいあたえダメージにおうじたまほうダメージをあたえる。(<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Celebrate: Perform an attack to leave the area feeling more festive. (<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いわいう：おまつりきぶんをもりじょうげるこうげきをいきう。(<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Behead: Consume all Soul Stacks, attacking with increased damage and accuracy per stack, and healing for <Num0> health per stack. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ざんしゅ： すべてのソウルスタックをきえひし、1スタックにつきダメージとめいちゅうりつがふくわえ、たいりょくを<Num0>かいふく。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Pulverize: A crushing blow with <Num0>% bonus accuracy that will reduce your target's defence by <Num1>%. (<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ふんさい： めいちゅうりつ+<Num0>%でてきをふんさいし、たいしょうのしゅびりょくを<Num1>%ていしたさせる。(<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Burning barrage: Attacks <Num0> times in quick succession, with a chance to burn the enemy on each hit. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: バーニング・バラージ：<Num0>かいつつづきでこうげきし、たしかりつでいちげきごとにてきをひきずさせる。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Scorching shackles: A scorching shot with <Num0>% bonus accuracy that will bind and burn enemy demons for <Num1> seconds.) (<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しゃくねつのあしかせ：めいちゅうりつ+<Num0>%のやをはなしち、あくまのてきを<Num1>びょうあいだこうたばしやききゃくする。 (<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Scatter ashes: Casts the highest available demonbane spell. If it kills a demon, it refunds its special attack energy cost, and reduces the next attack delay. (<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: はいをまきさんらす： しようかのうなもっともきょういあくまとくこうじゅもんをとなえる。あくまをたおれしたばあい、ひっさつわざエネルギーをきえひぶんかいふく、つぎのこうげきまでのクールタイムをへすこし。(<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Weaken: Temporarily drain your target's Attack, Strength and Defence by <Num0>%. Is three times as effective against demons. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: じゃくからだか：てきのこうげきりょく・わんりょく・しゅびりょくを<Num0>%ていした。あくまにたいしてききちからは３ばい。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Division: Fire a powerful piercing blade that reduces the targets Defence by <Num0>% of their Magic Level. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ディビジョン：たいしょうのしゅびりょくをまほうレベルの<Num0>%へすこしさせるきょうりょくなやいばをはなしつ。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Break Shackles: Attack with increased accuracy and damage based on the duration of any binding spells affecting them and ending said effect. This special attack requires the full Frostmoon set to be worn. (<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: そくばくからのひらきはなし：こうたばじゅもんのこうかじかんにおうじてめいちゅうりつ+とダメージ+でこうげきし、こうたばこうかをしゅうりょうさせる。はつうごきじょうけん：ぜんブルームーンそうびをそうちゃくすること。(<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Blood infusion: Sacrifice <Num0>% of your current hp to deal an attack with <Num1>% increased accuracy and damage, with a guaranteed set effect activation on hit. This special attack requires the full Bloodrager set to be worn. (<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ちえきそそいり：あらわれたいりょくの<Num0>%をぎせいに、めいちゅうりつとダメージが<Num1>%ふくわえしたこうげきをする。はつうごきじょうけん：ぜんブラッドムーンそうびをそうちゃくすること。(<Num2>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Eclipse: Attack with <Num0>% increased accuracy, consuming all remaining burn damage affecting the target and raising the max hit by that amount. This special attack requires the full Eclipse set to be worn. (<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: げっしょく：めいちゅうりつ+<Num0>%でこうげき。たいしょうにのこりっているもえやきダメージをすべてきえひし、さいだいダメージをそのぶんじょうげる。はつうごきじょうけん：ぜんエクリプスそうびをそうちゃくすること。（<Num1>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Virulence: Instantly metabolize any poison you are suffering from to buff your next attack by that amount of damage. (<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: びょうはらせい：じぶんがうけているどくをそくざにだいしゃし、つぎのこうげきをダメージぶんふくわえ。(<Num0>%)
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: mainTabs source: combatOptionsTab wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Your Attack level is used to determine how likely you are to hit your target in melee combat. A higher Attack level will give you a better chance to hit.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: こうげきりょくスキルはきんせつこうげきのめいちゅうりつのけいさんにつかいわれ、レベルがこういほどめいちゅうりつもこうくなります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Additionally, a higher Attack level will allow you to wield more powerful weapons. A weapon with a higher Attack bonus will give you more accuracy in combat.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: こうげきりょくレベルがこういとよりきょうりょくなぶきがそうびかのうになります。こうげきりょくボーナスがこういぶきをつかいうことでもきんせつこうげきのめいちゅうりつをじょうげることができます。こうげきりょくボーナスは「そうびしなのステータス」からかくにんかのうです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: You can select your Attack style from the Combat Options side panel. Different enemies are weaker or stronger against different Attack styles, so choose carefully.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: こうげきスタイルは、せんとうオプションのタブからせんたくできます。てきによってとくていのこうげきスタイルがじゃくてんだったりたいせいがあったりするのでしんちょうにえらびましょう。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As with any skill, you will restore <Num0> missing Hitpoint every minute, but the best way of recovering Hitpoints is by eating food.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ほかのスキルとどうよう、まいふん<Num0>のたいりょくをじどうかいふくしますがしょくべものをしょくべることですぐにかいふくできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Mining allows you to get various minerals from the world, for use in other skills; primarily Smithing.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: さいくつはかくちでさま々なこうぶつをとりとりすることをかのうにし、それらをほかのスキル、ぬしにかじでしようするためのスキルです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To mine a rock, simply interact with it while holding a pickaxe you have the level to use and you'll start mining it. Eventually, you'll collect the ore and the rock will deplete. Low level rocks will replenish themselves fairly quickly, but higher level ones will take longer and longer to come back.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いわをさいくつするには、レベルじょうけんをまんたしているツルハシをもちっていわをクリックします。しばらくするとこうせきをにゅうしゅし、いわはかわします。ていレベルのいわはくらべかくてきはやいくさいせいしますが、こうレベルのいわほどさいせいにじかんがかかります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: At higher mining levels, you'll have an increased chance of successfully mining a rock. You'll also be able to use more powerful pickaxes, which decrease the amount of time between mining attempts.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: さいくつレベルがじょうがると、いわをさいくつするせいこうりつがむかいじょうします。また、よりこうレベルなツルハシをしようできるようになり、さいくつのためしいきあいだのじかんがたんちぢみされます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Note that while most pickaxes have an Attack level requirement to equip them, you're still able to use them from within your inventory if you have the required Mining level.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ほとんどのツルハシはそうびするためにこうげきりょくレベルのじょうけんがひつようですが、ひつようなさいくつレベルをまんたしていれば、カバンからしようすることがかのうです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Your Strength level determines your max hit in combat. Whenever you hit your opponent, you will deal a random amount of damage up to your max hit.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: わんりょくレベルは、きんせつこうげきであたえるさいだいダメージをけっていします。てきにこうげきがいのちちゅうするたびに、さいだいダメージまでのランダムなダメージをあたえます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Most weapons have a Strength bonus that will also increase your max hit. You can view your Strength bonus (and all of your equipment's stats) by selecting 'View equipment stats' under the Worn Equipment side panel.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: おおいくのぶきにはわんりょくボーナスがあり、それもさいだいダメージをふやします。わんりょくボーナス（およびそうびしなのすべてのステータス）は、そうびしなタブで「そうびしなのステータスをひょうじ」からかくにんできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: うんどうしんけい：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Agility both increases the rate at which your Run Energy replenishes while not running and decreases the rate at which it drains while you run.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: うんどうしんけいは、はしりっていないときのはしりちからのかいふくはやいどをじょうのぼりさせ、はしりっているときのはしりちからきえひはやいどをへすこしさせます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: You will also gain access to useful shortcuts across Gielinor; these are marked with a green arrow on your map.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: また、ギレノーぜんいきにあるべんりなちかくみちをりようできるようになります。これらはマップじょうでみどりのやしるしでひょうじされています。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: In order to train your Agility skill, you will need an Agility course; these are a series of obstacles that reward experience upon completion.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: うんどうしんけいスキルをじょうげるには、「コース」できたえます。これらはいちつのしょうがいぶつでかまなりされており、かんりょうすることでけいけんちがえられます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Smithing lets you convert raw ores into useful metals, then use those metals to make your own weapons and armour.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: かじスキルはこうせきをみようてきなきんぞくにへんかんし、そのきんぞくをつかいってじぶんのぶきやぼうぐをさくることができるスキルです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To smelt ores, simply take the mix of ores you need to any furnace and you'll be able to convert them into bars.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: こうせきをようかいするにはひつようなこうせきをにんいのろにいりれます。するとそのこうせきのえんべぼうがてにいります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Once you have your bars, grab a hammer and take them to an anvil. Bigger items will need more bars to make.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: えんべぼうをゲットしたらハンマーをもってかなとこでそれをくわえこうしましょう。だいきなものをさくるにはよりおおいくのえんべぼうがひつようです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As you advance your Smithing level, you'll be able to make make more gear out of higher quality metals.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: かじレベルがじょうがるにつれ、よりこうレベルなきんぞくでよりおおいくのしゅるいのそうびをさくれるようになります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Your Defence level determines how likely you are to block enemy attacks. The chances of this happening increase with your level, but be careful; you are never guaranteed to block every attack!
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ぼうぎょちからレベルはてきのこうげきをぼうぐ（ダメージをうけない）たしかりつをけっていします。これがおきこるたしかりつはレベルがじょうがるにつれてふくわえしますが、すべてのこうげきをたしかさだめでぼうげるようにはなりません。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Additionally, a higher Defence level will allow you to equip more powerful shields and armour. As well as giving you better defensive stats, some armour will also increase your Attack or Strength bonuses as well.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: さらにぼうぎょちからレベルがこういほど、よりきょうりょくなぼうぐがそうびかのうになります。ぼうぎょステータスをむかいじょうさせるだけでなく、いちぶのぼうぐはこうげきりょくやわんりょくボーナスもふくわえさせます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ちょうごう：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Herblore allows you to make potions with herbs and ingredients found across Gielinor.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ちょうごうスキルでギレノーかくちでにゅうしゅできるやくそうとうをつかいってやくえきをさくることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To make a potion, you first need to clean a grimy herb, then combine it with a vial of water to make an unfinished potion. You can then add the secondary ingredient(s) to complete the potion.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: やくえきをさくるには、まずよごれたやくそうをきれいにし、それをみずいりしやくびんとくみあわせてみかんせいのやくえきをさくります。そのあと、ほたすけそざいをくわえることでやくえきをかんせいさせることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Fishing allows you to gather fish at various points across Gielinor. Typically, these will be indicated by moving bubbles on the surface of the water.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: つりスキルはギレノーかくちでさかなをつりるためのスキルです。つうじょう、さかなはみずめんのあわでばしょがとくていできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Different fish require different equipment to catch; for instance, you need a fishing net to catch shrimp, but a fishing rod and bait to catch sardines.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ことなるさかなをつりるには、それぞれことなるどうぐがひつようです。れいえば、エビをつりるにはぎょもうがひつようですが、イワシをつりるにはつりさおとエサがひつようです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As your Fishing level increases, you'll gain access to more varieties of fish to catch, as well as having a higher chance of successfully catching fish when you try.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: つりレベルがじょうがると、つりれるさかなのしゅるいがふえるだけでなく、つりのせいこうりつもじょうがります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Your Ranged level determines how accurate you are with ranged weapons, as well as how much damage they do. A higher Ranged level will result in more hits that do more damage.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: えんしゃレベルは、とおいきょりぶきのめいちゅうりつとあたえるダメージをけっていします。えんしゃレベルがこういほど、よりおおいくのこうげきがいのちちゅうし、よりだいきなダメージをあたえることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Most ranged weapons will need a specific kind of ammunition to go with them; for instance, bows will need arrows and crossbows will need bolts.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ほとんどのとおいへだぶきをつかいうにはとくていのしゅるいのだんがひつようです。れいえば、ゆみにはやが、クロスボウにはボルトがひつようです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As your Ranged level increases, you will also get access to more powerful weapons and ammunition. Typically, each ranged weapon can only handle ammo up to a certain level; for instance, an oak bow can only fire bronze, iron or steel arrows, but not mithril.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: えんしゃレベルがじょうがると、よりきょうりょくなぶきやだんくすりをしようできるようになります。つうじょう、かくとおいへだぶきはとくていのレベルまでのだんしかしようできません。れいえば、かしのゆみはせいどう、てつ、こうてつのやをしゃることはできますが、ミスリルのやはしようできません。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ぬすみ：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Thieving lets you steal items from various people and stalls. Be careful, as people won't take too kindly to you going through their pockets, and might call the guards on you, or may take matters into their own hands.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ぬすみは、さま々なひとややだいからアイテムをぬすみむことができるスキルです。ちゅういしてください。ひと々はポケットをさがしられることをかいくおもいわず、えいへいをよびばれることもあれば、じぶんでたいしょしようとすることもあります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As your Thieving level increases, the odds of you successfully stealing from your target will increase. You will also gain access to more lucrative targets with more valuable loot.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ぬすみレベルがじょうがると、ターゲットからのぬすみにせいこうするたしかりつがこうくなります。また、よりかちのあるぶっしをもちつ、よりりえきのだいきいターゲットからぬすみめるようになります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Cooking is a skill that lets you make all kinds of delicious food that will typically restore your Hitpoints, amongst providing other benefits.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: りょうりスキルは、さまざまなびあじしいしょくべものをさくることができるスキルで、つうじょうはたいりょくをかいふくするほか、さまざまなこうかをもたらします。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: At its most basic, Cooking can be done by simply taking raw meats and fish to either a fire or a range. You'll get better results overall if you use a range, though.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: りょうりのきほんてきなほうほうは、なまのにくやさかなをひまたはコンロにもちっていくだけでいきえます。コンロでちょうりしたほうがこげがしにくいです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Some foods will require you to prepare your ingredients before you can cook them. For example, you first need to mix flour and water into a dough before you can bake them into bread.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いちぶのしょくべものは、ちょうりするまえにざいりょうをじゅんびするひつようがあります。れいえば、パンはやきくまえに、こむぎことみずをこみぜてきじをさくるひつようがあります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As your Cooking level increases, you'll get access to an increasing list of recipes. You'll also find that you accidentally burn your food less of the time as well.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: りょうりレベルがじょうがると、ちょうりかのうなしょくべものやレシピがふえていきます。また、しょくべものをあやまってこげがしてしまうことがすこしなくなるでしょう。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Prayer allows you to access different prayers, available from the Prayer side panel. Each prayer offers a different powerful benefit.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いのりスキルは、いのりタブからせんたくかのうなさま々ないのりささげることができるようになるスキルです。かくいのりは、それぞれことなるきょうりょくなこうかをもたらします。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Using prayers will drain your prayer points over time. Once you run out of prayer points, you will be unable to use any prayers. You can restore your prayer points by praying at an altar.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いのりをしようすると、じょ々に「いのりりょく（きりょく）ポイント」がへります。いのりポイントがなくなると、いのりをしようできなくなります。いのりりょくポイントはさいだんでかいふくできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Some pieces of equipment will grant you a Prayer bonus, which will reduce the rate at which your prayer points are drained.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いちぶのそうびはいのりボーナスをふよし、いのりりょくポイントのしょうもうはやいどをへすこしさせるこうかがあります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: The most common way to increase your Prayer level is to offer the remains of the enemies you kill. Burying their bones and scattering their ashes will award you Prayer experience.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いのりレベルをじょうげるもっともいっぱんてきなほうほうは、たおれしたてきのいがいをささげることです。それらのほねをうめたり、はいをまいたりすることで、いのりスキルのけいけんちをかくとくできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: こうさく：いちぶかいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Crafting is a wide-ranging skill that allows you to create various pieces of armour, jewellery, equipment and more.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: こうさくははばひろいスキルで、さまざまなぼうぐ、ほうしょくひん、そうびしなどをさくなりすることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To craft armour out of animal hides, you'll typically first need to take the hides to a tanner to get them tanned, then combine them with a needle and thread, which can be acquired from certain crafting shops in the world.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: どうぶつのかわからぼうぐをさくるには、つうじょう、まずかわをタンナーのところにもちっていき、なしてもらうひつようがあります。そのあと、はりといとをつかいってくわえこうします。はりといとは、とくていのこうさくみせでにゅうしゅできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To make pottery, you'll need to obtain some soft clay, obtained by adding water to clay. You can then use a pottery wheel to shape the clay into an unfired item, which you can then finish in a pottery oven.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: とうきをさくるには、ねんどにみずをくわえてえられるやわらかいねんどをよういするひつようがあります。そのあと、とうげいようのろくろをつかいってねんどをかたちさくり、みしょうせいのアイテムをさくります。それをとうげいようのかまでやきじょうげてかんせいさせることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To make jewellery, you'll need to first get a crafting mould. You can then take that mould and some gold or silver bars to a furnace to craft your jewellery. At higher crafting levels, you can cut gems and mould them simultaneously to create jewellery which you can enchant!
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ほうしょくひんをさくるには、まずクラフティングようのいがたをてにいりれるひつようがあります。いがたときんまたはぎんのえんべぼうをろにもちっていきくことで、ほうしょくひんをさくることができます。こうさくレベルがじょうがると、ほうせきをカットしながらかたにいりれてくわえこうし、まほうふよかのうなほうしょくひんをさくれるようになります！
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Firemaking is a skill that allows you to make fires. To do so, simply use a tinderbox on a set of logs and you'll attempt to light them on fire.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ひおこしスキルは、ひをおきこすためのスキルです。ひくちばこをまるたにつかいうことで、ひをつけようとしはじめます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Higher Firemaking levels will allow you to burn logs that grant more experience, as well as allowing you to burn them quicker.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: レベルがじょうがると、よりおおいくのけいけんちをえられるまるたをもえやせるようになり、さらにすばやいくもえやせるようになります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Magic grants you access to a wide variety of spells. To cast each spell, you will need a specific set of runes. You can see the runes required by inspecting the spell in either the side panel, or in their tab in this skill guide.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: まほうスキルはさま々なじゅもんをしようかのうにします。かくじゅもんをとなえるには、とくていのしゅるいのルーンがひつようです。ひつようなルーンは、じゅもんタブやこのスキルガイドのタブでじゅもんをかくにんすることでかくにんできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: You can use certain pieces of equipment to replace runes in order to cast spells. For instance, an equipped staff of air counts as an infinite supply of air runes.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: とくていのそうびをしようすることで、ルーンをせつやくしてじゅもんをとなえることができます。れいえば、そうびしたたいきのつえはむげんのたいきルーンとしてあつかいわれます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Staves can also be used to auto-cast certain offensive spells in combat; to enable this, equip your staff, go to the Combat Options side panel, and select one of the 'Spell' options.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: つえやしゃくはせんとうちゅうにとくていのこうげきじゅもんをじどうでとなえるためにもしようできます。まずつえをそうびし、せんとうオプションのサイドパネルにいどうして、「じゅもん」オプションからせんたくしてください。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: もくざいかこう：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Fletching allows you to create various ranged weapons, as well as ammunition to go with them.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: もくざいかこうは、さまざまなとおいきょりぶきやそれにたいおうするだんくすりをさくなりできるスキルです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Making bows requires bowstring, which can be made from flax at a spinning wheel. You can use a knife on some logs to carve an unfinished bow, then add the bowstring to complete the weapon.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ゆみをさくるにはゆみづるがひつようで、ゆみづるはかいしくるまであまからさくることができます。まるたにナイフをつかいってみかんせいのゆみをほり、そのあとゆみづるをむすびぶことでゆみをさくなりすることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To create arrows, you'll first need to carve logs into arrow shafts with a knife, then tip the arrow shafts with feathers. Finally, you'll need to add some arrow heads.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: やをさくるには、まずまるたをナイフでくわえこうしてやのシャフトをさくり、そのあと、シャフトにはねをとりつきけるひつようがあります。さいごに、やじりをとりつきければかんせいです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To make bolts, you only need to combine unfinished bolts with feathers. You can also chisel gemstones down into bolt tips, with each gemstone being able to top a different bolt.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ボルトをさくるにはかじでさくったみかんせいのボルトにはねをとりつきけます。また、ノミでほうせきをほってボルトのせんたんにとりつきけるボルトチップをさくれます。ほうせきのしゅるいによって、たいおうするボルトがことなります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Woodcutting allows you to chop down trees to obtain logs. Most trees in the game can be chopped down with an axe.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: きこりは、きをばっさいしてまるたをてにいりれることができるスキルです。ほとんどのきはおのをつかいってばっさいすることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Increasing your Woodcutting level will give you a higher chance of successfully chopping a tree. You'll also gain access to more trees to cut down.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: きこりレベルをじょうげることで、きをばっさいするせいこうりつがこうくなります。さらに、ばっさいできるきのしゅるいもふえていきます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: In addition to this, higher Woodcutting levels grant access to more powerful axes, which also increase the chance of chopping trees. Note that you can still use an axe in your inventory if you have the Woodcutting level for it, even if you don't have the Attack level to equip it.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: そのほか、レベルがじょうがると、よりきょうりょくなおのをしようできるようになり、それによってきをばっさいするせいこうりつもむかいじょうします。なお、そうびするためのこうげきりょくレベルがあしりなくても、きこりレベルがまんたされていれば、カバンのちゅうのおのをしようすることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Runecrafting is the skill that allows you to convert essences into runes, which you can use to cast spells.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ルーンさくりは、ルーンのそを、じゅもんをとなえるためにひつようなルーンにへんかんするスキルです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To create runes, you'll first need some essence and a talisman of the rune you want to make. You can use the talisman to both locate and access the runic altar, which is where the runes are crafted.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ルーンをさくなりするには、まずルーンのそと、さくなりしたいルーンにたいおうするタリスマンがひつようです。タリスマンは、ルーンをさくなりするばしょであるルーンのさいだんをみつけることと、そのさいだんにアクセスするためにしようできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Higher Runecrafting levels will allow you to craft more kinds of runes. At higher levels, you'll also be able to make multiple runes per essence.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ルーンさくりレベルがじょうがると、よりおおいくのしゅるいのルーンをさくなりできるようになります。さらにこういレベルでは、1つのルーンのそからふくすうのルーンをさくなりすることもかのうになります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: とうばつ：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Slayer is a skill that lets you fight increasingly dangerous and lucrative monsters. Some monsters can only be fought if you have a high enough Slayer level.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: とうばつスキルは、よりきけんでほうしゅうかちのこういモンスターとせんうことをかのうにします。いちぶのモンスターは、じゅうぶんにこういスレイヤーレベルがなければせんうことができません。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To get started with Slayer, you'll first need a Slayer task, which can be obtained from a Slayer Master. You can then kill the assigned target to get Slayer experience.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: とうばつをはじめるには、まずとうばつのたつじんからとうばついらいをうけとりるひつようがあります。そのあと、していされたとうばつたいしょうをたおれすことでとうばつスキルのけいけんちをかくとくできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Once you've completed five tasks, you can start earning reward points, which can be used to skip or block tasks you don't want, or purchase various items and benefits like extended tasks.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: 5つのいらいをかんりょうすると、ほうしゅうポイントをかくとくできるようになります。このポイントは、やりたくないいらいをスキップやブロックしたり、いらいえんちょうなどのアイテムなどのこうにゅうにしようできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: のうぎょう：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Farming allows you to grow various flowers, vegetables, trees, herbs and more in farming patches across Gielinor.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: のうぎょうは、ギレノーかくちのはたけでさまざまなはな、やさい、き、ハーブなどをそだてることができるスキルです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To get started, you'll need some seeds and a seed dibber, as well as a rake to de-weed the patch you want to use.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: のうぎょうスキルをじょうげるには、たねとたねまきうつわ、さらにうえるはたけのざっそうをとりのぞきくためのくまでがひつようです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Once you've cleared the patch, you can add your seed to it. You can also optionally water it with a watering can or add a bucket of compost to decrease the chances of your plant becoming diseased.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ざっそうをかきぬきいたらたねをうえます。にんいでジョウロでみずをやったり、バケツにいりったたいひをくわえたりすることで、しょくぶつがびょうきになるかのうせいをへらすことができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: It'll take a while for your plant to grow, so feel free to explore the world and come back to it later!
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょくぶつがなりながするまでにはじかんがかかるので、せかいをさがしさくしながらあとでもどりってきてもだいじょうぶです！
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Once your plant has grown, you might need another tool to collect the harvest. For instance, you'll need a shovel to dig up potatoes.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょくぶつがなりながしたら、しゅうかくするためにべつのどうぐがひつようになるばあいがあります。れいえば、ジャガイモをほりおきこすにはシャベルがひつようです。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: If you're worried about your crops becoming diseased, most crops can be protected by the nearby gardeners, but they'll want specific produce in return.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: さくものがびょうきになるのがしんぱいなら、ちかくのにわしにたのみめばほとんどのさくものをまもりってもらえますが、そのだいわりにとくていののうさんものをようきゅうされます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As your Farming level increases, you'll gain access to more crops to grow, as well as obtaining greater yields when harvesting.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: のうぎょうレベルがじょうがると、そだてられるさくものしゅるいがふえるだけでなく、しゅうかくときにえられるしゅうかくりょうもふくわえします。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: けんちく：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Construction gives you access to your very owned Player-Owned House. To get started, you'll need to buy a house from an Estate agent.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: けんちくは、プレイヤーせんようのいえをところあすることをかのうにするスキルです。まずふどうさんぎょうものからいえをこうにゅうするひつようがあります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Once you have a house, you'll need to build furniture. Most furniture can be built with planks, which can be obtained via taking logs to a sawmill.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いえをてにいりれたら、いえぐをさくるひつようがあります。ほとんどのいえぐはいたでさくることができ、これらはまるたをせいざいしょにもちっていくことでにゅうしゅできます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: To build furniture, grab a hammer and a saw, enter your house in build mode, select a hotspot and select the furniture you want to build.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: いえぐをさくるには、ハンマーとノコギリをもち、けんちくモードでじぶんのいえにいり、ホットスポットをせんたくしてさくりたいいえぐをえらびます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As your Construction level increases, you'll be able to build bigger houses, gain access to more kinds of room in your house, and be able to build fancier furniture.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: けんちくレベルがじょうがると、よりだいきないえをたてられるようになり、いえのちゅうについかできるへやのしゅるいがふえたり、よりごうかないえぐをさくれるようになります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: かりゅうど：かいいんかぎさだめ
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Hunter lets you track and catch a wide variety of wildlife, granting access to various unique materials in the process.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: かりゅうどは、さまざまなやせいどうぶつをついせきしてほかくすることができるスキルで、ユニークなそざいをにゅうしゅすることができます。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Each animal you can hunt will typically be found in a specfic locale, and will require different gear. Make sure you come prepared!
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: かりりょうできるどうぶつはつうじょうとくていのちいきになまいきしており、それぞれことなるそうびがひつようになります。しっかりじゅんびしましょう！
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: As your Hunter level improves, not only will you be able to hunt a wider variety of creatures, but you'll also be able to maintain more traps simultaneously, and they will successfully trap creatures more often.
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: ハンターレベルがじょうがると、かりりょうできるせいぶつのしゅるいがふえるだけでなく、どうじにせっおきできるわなのかずがふえ、わながせいこうするたしかりつもこうくなります。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: generalUI source: skillGuide wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat Elidinis' Warden in phase three of the Wardens fight with 'Aerial Assault', 'Stay vigilant' and 'Insanity' invocations activated and without dying yourself.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>エリディニスのかんししゃを「くうちゅうこうげき」、「あぶらことわだいてき」、「おろかいき」のいのりねがいをはつうごきし、しなずに、かんししゃをフェーズ３で、じぶんはしなずにたおれす。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat the Wardens with all Wardens invocations activated, at expert level and without dying yourself.</col>

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete phase three of The Wardens in a group of two or more, using only melee attacks and without dying yourself. The 'Insanity' invocation must be activated.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>かんししゃのフェーズ３をにひといじょうのチームで、きんせつこうげきだけで、じぶんはしなずにとつはする。「おろかいき」のいのりねがいをはつうごきしているひつようがある。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete Akkha in a group of two or more, without anyone taking any hits from the following: Akkha's attacks off-prayer, Akkha's special attacks (orbs, memory, detonate), exploding shadow timers, orbs in the enrage phase or attacking Akkha with the wrong style. Hits for zero damage still count. You must have all Akkha invocations activated.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>アクハをにひといじょうのチームでたおれす。このさいだれもつぎのこうげきをうけてはいけない：アクハのとくしゅこうげき（オーブ、しるしおく、ばくは）、かげのタイマーのばくは、あばれはしりフェーズのオーブ。さらに、まちがいったこうげきスタイルでアクハをこうげきしてはいけない。０ダメのヒットもふくみむ。また、ぜんてのアクハのいのりねがいをはつうごきしていないといけない。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat Ba-Ba in a group of two or more, without anyone taking any hits from the following: Ba-Ba's Attacks off-prayer, Ba-Ba's slam, rolling boulders, rubble attack or falling rocks. Hits for zero damage still count. No sarcophagi may be opened. You must have all Ba-Ba invocations activated.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>つぎのダメージをうけずににひといじょうのチームでバーバをたおれす：ぼうぎょのいのりたいしょうそとのバーバのこうげきをうける、バーバのふみつけ、ころがりがるきょいし、がれきこうげき、おちいし。０ダメのヒットもふくみむ。ただしいしひつぎをひらきかずにたっせいすること。また、バーバのいのりねがいをぜんてはつうごきしていること。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat Zebak without anyone taking any hits from: poison, Zebak's basic attacks off-prayer, blood spawns and waves. You also must not push more than two jugs on the roar attack during the fight (you may destroy stationary ones). Hits for zero damage still count. You must have all Zebak invocations activated.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>ゼバックのつぎのこうげきからだれもダメージうけずにたおれす：どく、ぼうぎょのいのりたいしょうそとのゼバックのつうじょうこうげき、、ちのはらことウェーブ。ほうこうげきでジャグを２ついじょうおしてはいけない（しずかとめしているものはたいしょうそと）。０ダメのヒットもふくみむ。ゼバックのいのりねがいをぜんてはつうごきしているひつようがある。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat Kephri in a group of two or more, without anyone taking any hits from the following: egg explosions, Kephri's attacks, Exploding Scarabs, Bodyguards, dung attacks. xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat The Wardens in a group of two or more, without anyone taking avoidable hits from the following: Warden attacks, obelisk attacks, lightning attacks in phase three, skull attack in phase three, Demi god attacks in phase three. xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Kill the Crazy Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Rain of Knowledge" attack.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>きょうったこうこがくしゃを「しりめぐのあめ」のこうげきをうけずにたおれす。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Kill the Deranged Archaeologist without anyone being hit by his "Learn to Read" attack.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>さくみだしたこうこがくしゃを「よむことをまなびべ」のこうげきをうけずにたおれす。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Kill the Grotesque Guardians whilst completing the "Don't look at the eclipse", "Prison Break", "Granite footwork", "Heal no more", "Static Awareness" and "Done before dusk" tasks.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>グロテスク・ガーディアンを「げっしょくをみるな」「ぬごく」「かこうがんのフットワーク」「かいふくはもうやめ」「ふへんてきいしき」「ゆうくれまえにおわりわらせる」のじょうけんをぜんてまんたしてたおれす。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete the Tombs of Amascut with the "On a diet" and "Dehydration" invocations activated and without anyone dying.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>アマスカットのはかを「しょくことせいげん」と「ぬみずしょうじょう」のいのりねがいをはつうごきし、だれもしなずにふはする。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete Wave <Num0> with either "Red Flag", "Dynamic Duo", or "Doom II" active.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: せつめい: <colNum0><Num0>ばん をかんりょうしてください "あかい はたじるし", "ばらばら おりもの", または "しゅうまつ II" のいずれか あくていか。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete the Theatre of Blood without anyone dying through any means and whilst everyone in the team completes the following Combat Achievement tasks in a single run: "Perfect Maiden", "Perfect Bloat", "Perfect Nylocas", "Perfect Sotetseg", "Perfect Xarpus" and "Perfect Verzik".</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>ちのげきじょうを、だれもしなずに、ぜんいんがいちかいのこうりゃくでつぎのせんとうじっせきのじょうけんをまんたし、こうりゃくする：「おとめにかんぜんしょうり」「ブロートにかんぜんしょうり」「ソテツセグにかんぜんしょうり」「ハープスにかんぜんしょうり」「ヴァージックにかんぜんしょうり」</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat Sol Heredit with the "Bees! II", "Quartet", and "Solarflare II" modifiers active.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>ソル・ヘレディットを「ハチ! ２」「カルテット」「たいようフレア２」のこうかはつうごきしてたおれす。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Kill the Grotesque Guardians whilst completing the "Don't look at the eclipse", "Prison Break", "Granite footwork", "Heal no more", "Static Awareness" and "Done before dusk" tasks.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>グロテスク・ガーディアンを「げっしょくをみるな」「ぬごく」「かこうがんのフットワーク」「かいふくはもうやめ」「ふへんてきいしき」「ゆうくれまえにおわりわらせる」のじょうけんをぜんてまんたしてたおれす。</col>

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete the Tombs of Amascut with the "On a diet" and "Dehydration" invocations activated and without anyone dying.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>アマスカットのはかを「しょくことせいげん」と「ぬみずしょうじょう」のいのりねがいをはつうごきし、だれもしなずにふはする。
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete Wave <Num0> with either "Red Flag", "Dynamic Duo", or "Doom II" active.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: せつめい: <colNum0><Num0>ばん をかんりょうしてください "あかい はたじるし", "ばらばら おりもの", または "しゅうまつ II" のいずれか あくていか。</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Complete the Theatre of Blood without anyone dying through any means and whilst everyone in the team completes the following Combat Achievement tasks in a single run: "Perfect Maiden", "Perfect Bloat", "Perfect Nylocas", "Perfect Sotetseg", "Perfect Xarpus" and "Perfect Verzik".</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>ちのげきじょうを、だれもしなずに、ぜんいんがいちかいのこうりゃくでつぎのせんとうじっせきのじょうけんをまんたし、こうりゃくする：「おとめにかんぜんしょうり」「ブロートにかんぜんしょうり」「ソテツセグにかんぜんしょうり」「ハープスにかんぜんしょうり」「ヴァージックにかんぜんしょうり」</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:note: category: interface sub_category: combAchvmt source: wiki_url: None

xliff:trans-unit.xliff:source: Description: <colNum0>Defeat Sol Heredit with the "Bees! II", "Quartet", and "Solarflare II" modifiers active.</col>
xliff:trans-unit.xliff:target: しょうさい：<colNum0>ソル・ヘレディットを「ハチ! ２」「カルテット」「たいようフレア２」のこうかはつうごきしてたおれす。</col>
